reviews.author: William Ngoh
reviews.text: Went to LT for android player and got it done very fast! Was skeptical at first and afraid of all the upselling or hard selling of higher end products but didnt face any at all.. Friendly staff recommended and explained on some features and boss is very friendly too. This will definitely be the only shop i will be patronizing from now on. 👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: ila ali
reviews.text: I recently purchased an Android player and installed a GR steering from LT Automart, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The salesman, Mr. Jie, was extremely knowledgeable and patient, taking the time to answer all my questions thoroughly. What impressed me most was their honesty and transparency in pricing — no hidden costs, no gimmicks.

reviews.author: Nobodyz
reviews.text: Went to install auto tailgate for my car. Staff was very friendly, patient and nice. Made sure everything is ok and went through with me. Price is reasonable as well (speaking as a Malaysian working in sg).
